fact: The Global Fund case study says a health information exchange is under development to connect laboratories, logistics information management systems and DHIS2 to Impilo, and that a national health information exchange platform is being developed with Global Fund support.

In a presentation of 18 July 2026 the Civil Registry Department states it is implementing a secure interoperability platform to exchange birth and death notifications with the Ministry of Health and Child Care, with API/middleware design due Q4 2026 and a three-province pilot in Q1-Q2 2027.

UNDP Zimbabwe published a request for proposals, UNDP-ZWE-01688, for technical assistance to develop a Health Information Exchange Platform, with a deadline of 22 June 2026; the public notice gives no scope.

A DHIS2 community post says Impilo EHR, deployed across over 700 facilities, sends data to DHIS2 using FHIR, by real-time OpenHIE pipeline for connected facilities, reporting over 150 indicators and 15 facility registers; as_of is the post's published date.
